differentialDeviationTest

Source: R/differential_analysis.R
differentialDeviationTest.Rd

Test which motifs have different deviation scores between groups of samples. Adapted from chromVAR::differentialDeviations.

Usage

differentialDeviationTest(
  deviations,
  groups = NULL,
  motifs = rownames(deviations),
  alternative = c("two.sided", "less", "greater"),
  parametric = TRUE,
  padjMethod = "BH"
)

Arguments

deviations

A methylTFRdeviations object, or a matrix or data.frame of deviation scores with motifs in rows and samples in columns.

groups

A vector with one group label per sample. If NULL, the column names of deviations are used. For two groups, the factor levels set the direction of mean_difference.

motifs

Motif names, by default rownames(deviations).

alternative

The alternative hypothesis of the two-group tests, one of "two.sided", "less" or "greater".

parametric

Logical. If TRUE (default), parametric tests are used, otherwise non-parametric tests.

padjMethod

Method for p-value adjustment, passed to p.adjust. Default "BH".

Value

A data.frame with one row per motif and the columns motifs, p_value, p_value_adjusted and mean_difference. For two groups, mean_difference is the mean of the first group minus the mean of the second; for more groups, it is the range of the group means.

Details

With two groups, a Welch t-test (parametric = TRUE) or a Wilcoxon rank sum test is used; with more groups, a one-way ANOVA or a Kruskal-Wallis test.

See also

computeZScoreVariability for ranking motifs without group labels.

Examples

load(system.file("extdata", "tc_mem.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "tc_naive.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
devs <- cbind(tc_mem, tc_naive)

# Construct group labels from sample names
groups <- sub("\\.bedGraph.*$", "", vapply(
    strsplit(colnames(devs), split = "_"), `[`, character(1), 1L
))

tc_result <- differentialDeviationTest(
    deviations = devs,
    groups = groups,
    alternative = "two.sided",
    parametric = TRUE,
    padjMethod = "BH"
)
head(tc_result)
#>                  motifs      p_value p_value_adjusted mean_difference
#> FOXF2             FOXF2 1.694736e-02     0.0355317162      0.02920759
#> FOXD1             FOXD1 3.644010e-01     0.4555013119     -0.01081636
#> IRF2               IRF2 1.873667e-03     0.0093683362     -0.03414276
#> MZF1(var.2) MZF1(var.2) 1.776586e-02     0.0355317162     -0.01850831
#> MAX::MYC       MAX::MYC 1.078111e-05     0.0001078111     -0.09341429
#> PPARG             PPARG 3.996324e-03     0.0133210805     -0.03428684
